title: Endogenous supply-chain transformation via dynamically calibrated nonneutroelastic processing networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.15452v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how supply chains endogenously transform requires a parametric model of processing networks with non-neutral substitution elasticities. While the Cascaded CES (CCES) production function provides a rigorous framework for these multi-layered linkages, dynamically calibrating its structural parameters from time-series data constitutes a highly non-convex inverse optimization problem. Enforcing the strict microeconomic concavity constraint causes standard monolithic approach to fail due to extreme ill-conditioning and the curse of dimensionality. To overcome this computational bottleneck, we propose a novel structure-exploiting algorithm. By leveraging the physical upstreamness topology of the network, our hybrid heuristic alternates between a vertical cascade-sequential descent and a horizontal block coordinate descent. translated_title: 基于动态校准的非中性弹性加工网络的内生供应链转型
translated_abstract: 理解供应链如何实现内生转型，需要一个具有非中性替代弹性的加工网络参数化模型。虽然级联CES（CCES）生产函数为这些多层关联提供了严格的框架，但从时间序列数据动态校准其结构参数构成了一个高度非凸的逆优化问题。强制施加严格的微观经济凹性约束，会使标准的整体式方法因极端病态性和维数灾难而失效。为克服这一计算瓶颈，我们提出了一种新颖的利用结构特征的算法。通过利用网络的物理上游拓扑结构，我们的混合启发式算法在垂直级联顺序下降与水平块坐标下降之间交替进行。我们的框架成功校准了一个10部门宏观经济模型的基本弹性……
tldr: 本文提出一种利用网络物理上游拓扑结构的混合启发式算法，通过垂直级联顺序下降与水平块坐标下降的交替优化，克服了非凸性、病态性与维数灾难等难题，实现了级联CES生产函数结构参数的动态校准，从而为供应链内生转型建模提供了可行工具。
en_tdlr: We propose a structure-exploiting hybrid heuristic that alternates between vertical cascade-sequential descent and horizontal block coordinate descent, overcoming non-convexity, ill-conditioning, and the curse of dimensionality to dynamically calibrate Cascaded CES production function parameters for modeling endogenous supply-chain transformation.
